Analyze locally synced data with count, group-by, and summary operations.
Data must be synced first with the sync command.

Usage:
  youtube-pp-cli analytics [flags]

Examples:
  # Count records by type
  youtube-pp-cli analytics --type messages

  # Group by a field
  youtube-pp-cli analytics --type messages --group-by author_id

  # Top 10 most frequent values
  youtube-pp-cli analytics --type messages --group-by channel_id --limit 10 --json
